summary: Short kerb beside bush at a bend, but homes 13-19 m away and steep.

best_section.where: south kerb at the bend, beside the bushland

drivers.seclusion: Bush behind the south kerb. A house about 19 m north across the road and another 13 m along, so homes are within 25 m.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with a grass verge on the bush side; no cars parked, room beside the lane looks adequate.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential street end near a junction with a larger road to the west.
drivers.convention: No parked cars and no marked parking; no overnight convention.

flags: Steep: about 5% at the best section, 6.5% overall
Low-lying: lowest point 12 m, waterway 34 m away
sun_shade: Bush to the east and south shades the morning; open to the west afternoon sun.
